title: Transition Fills for New Enrollees and First Fills after an Injury — Prescription Insurance on File
content:
## Transition fill

Under **Prescription Insurance on File**, where the plan class pays transition fills, a drug the patient was already taking that the plan rejects product not covered or prior authorization required is paid once per prescription as a transition fill, on the transition fill basis, with a days supply of at most the class's largest transition fill days supply.

- **Window.** A transition fill is billed no later than the plan's effective date plus the class's transition window days, counted in calendar days with the effective date as day 0. The effective date is read from the coverage record, and the last day of the window still qualifies.
- **Once only.** Only one transition fill is paid per prescription, counted as the paid, unreversed transition-fill claims for the prescription dated from the coverage's effective date through the effective date plus the transition window days.
- **Purpose.** A transition fill gives the patient time to switch drugs or obtain a prior authorization, and is never repeated when the window ends.

## First fill before an injury claim is accepted

Where the class's first fill before acceptance is above 0 days, the first fill after an injury is paid for up to that many days, on the first fill basis, before the injury claim is accepted.

## Window boundary (hypothetical: effective date 1 January of a non-leap year, 90-day window)

| Transition fill billed on | Day count | Within the window? |
|---|---|---|
| 31 March | day 89 | Yes |
| 1 April | day 90 | Yes — last qualifying day |
| 2 April | day 91 | No |

## Points of judgement

| Situation | Transition fill paid? |
|---|---|
| Class pays transition fills; drug already taken; rejected product not covered; within the window; no earlier transition fill for this prescription | Yes, up to the class's largest transition days supply |
| Same, but a transition fill for this prescription was already paid and not reversed | No — one per prescription |
| Same, but a transition fill for this prescription was paid and later reversed | The reversed claim is not counted |
| Class does not pay transition fills | No |
